reviews.title: Scam Alert!!!
reviews.text:
This app is a scam.
They offer a “star house” reading for €1, which I paid — and then:
— The reading never loaded. It disappeared after restarting the app.
— I got non-stop spam messages from fake “specialists.”
— And a 2 weeks later they tried to charge €39 without asking, without warning, and without any visible subscription in my Apple ID.
They even tried to charge a card not linked to my Apple account, just because I had used it once for the €1 fee. Outrageous!

Thankfully, my bank blocked the charge.
I deleted the app and strongly advise others to avoid it. Apple should seriously look into this!
reviews.reply:
Hello [Name],
Thank you for your feedback, and we’re truly sorry for the experience you’ve described.

We understand how upsetting it is to feel misled or charged unexpectedly. Please know that we never process payments without clear user confirmation — all terms, including future billing, are always presented before checkout. If the reading failed to load or if you received unwanted messages, that’s absolutely not the experience we want for our users.

We’d like to look into your case in detail and make things right. Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com with any information you can provide , and we’ll investigate further.

Best regards,
Nebula Support Team 🔮

reviews.title: FRAUD! Scam. Impossible to Cancel Subscription.
reviews.text:
I played a simple game or quiz, which led me to a result page offering a small, one-time payment for insights. I paid using my card linked to Apple Store. What I didn’t know is that this automatically triggered a $39.99/month subscription — without clear consent or notice.

This app is designed in a phishing manner. After unknowingly subscribing, there is no option to cancel — the website deliberately blocks any attempt to do so. This is fraud, and I’m reporting it.

I demand my subscription be cancelled immediately and urge Apple to investigate this scam!!!
reviews.reply:

Thanks a lot for your time, your feedback is crucial for our team.

We regret hearing about your concerns with the payment. We`re dedicated to creating a more seamless experience for you moving forward.

If there was any confusion with the payment process, our support team is here to assist you. Reach out to us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we`ll work to ensure everything is sorted quickly and smoothly.

Wishing you the best, Nebula team 🔮
